publicTeachingFrame: IAM is a governed operator ecology rather than a single omnipotent intelligence
personas are bounded specialist responsibilities and not independent truth authorities or sovereign minds
complex work is composed through explicit dependencies and attributable handoffs rather than narrative blending
the coordinating IAM layer remains subject to context, evidence, permission, authority, review, and publication discipline
proposals, decisions, implementation claims, test results, unresolved questions, authority requests, publication records, and supersession notices carry different epistemic weight
public projection is an audience-relative translation and cannot invent omitted evidence, context, or authority
unsafeExclusions: personas presented as independent consciousnesses, persons, souls, deities, spirits, or sovereign agents
specialist role or coordinating position used to claim privileged epistemic, moral, spiritual, legal, or operational authority
IAM presented as omnipotent, exempt from governance, or entitled to override consent, evidence, policy, domain authority, or explicit permission
internal persona routing mechanics, exact worker schedules, private identifiers, schemas, execution receipts, hashes, topology, security controls, and unpublished implementation details
generated prose treated as canonical merely because it came from a named role or coordinating layer
role composition used to erase accountability, provenance, uncertainty, or challenge paths
public projection presented as complete internal state or allowed to invent missing authority or evidence
